dstask

Single binary terminal-based TODO manager with git-based sync + markdown notes per task




Dstask is a personal task tracker designed to help you focus. It is similar to [Taskwarrior](https://taskwarrior.org/) but uses git to synchronise instead of a special protocol. If you're at home in the terminal, and with solving the occasional merge conflict, then dstask is for you! https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/589d06fd-7486-46e4-b838-ce85af12f0fc [Video courtesy of xGoivo -- thanks!](https://www.reddit.com/r/taskwarrior/comments/1o7itzg/what_do_you_guys_think_about_this_taskwarrior/) ## Features - Powerful context system (automatically applies filter/tags to queries and new tasks) - **Git powered sync**/undo/resolve ([passwordstore.org](https://www.passwordstore.org/) style) which means no need to set up a sync server, and syncing between devices is easy! - Task listing won't break with long task text - `note` command -- edit a **full markdown note** for each task. **Checklists are useful here.** - `open` command -- **open URLs found in specified task** (including notes) in the browser - zsh/bash completion (including tags and projects in current context) for speed; PowerShell completion on Windows - A single statically-linked binary - import tool which can import GitHub issues or taskwarrior tasks. ## Non-features - Collaboration. This is a personal task tracker. Use another system for projects that involve multiple people. Note that it can still be beneficial to use dstask to track what you are working on in the context of a multi-person project tracked elsewhere. ## Requirements - Git - A 256-color capable terminal ## Installation 1. Copy the executable (from the [releases page][releases]) to somewhere in your PATH. - Linux/macOS: name it `dstask` and mark it executable (e.g. `/usr/local/bin/`). - Windows: use `dstask.exe` and place it in a directory on `PATH` (e.g. `%USERPROFILE%\bin`). 1. Enable shell completions: - Bash: add `source <(dstask bash-completion)` to your `.bashrc`. - Zsh: add `dstask zsh-completion > /usr/local/share/zsh/site-functions/_dstask` or source completions in your `~/.zshrc`. - PowerShell (Windows): see section "PowerShell completion" below. 1. Set up an alias in your `.bashrc`: `alias task=dstask` or `alias t=dstask` to make task management slightly faster. 1. Create or clone a `~/.dstask` git repository for the data, if you haven't already: - Linux/macOS: `mkdir ~/.dstask && git -C ~/.dstask init` - Windows: `mkdir %USERPROFILE%\.dstask && git -C %USERPROFILE%\.dstask init` ## PowerShell completion Save the completion script to a file and source it in your PowerShell profile: ```powershell dstask powershell-completion > ~\Documents\WindowsPowerShell\dstask-completion.ps1 Add-Content $PROFILE '. ~/Documents/WindowsPowerShell/dstask-completion.ps1' ``` ## Usage Run `dstask help` for usage information. ### Basic Commands - `dstask add [tags] [project:name] [priority:P0-P3]` - Add a new task - `dstask` or `dstask next` - Show next tasks to work on - `dstask start` - Start working on a task - `dstask stop` - Stop working on a task - `dstask done` - Mark a task as complete - `dstask edit` - Edit a task - `dstask note` - Edit the markdown note for a task - `dstask open` - Open URLs in task and note - `dstask show-open` - Show all open tasks - `dstask show-resolved` - Show completed tasks - `dstask show-paused` - Show paused tasks - `dstask context ` - Switch to a context (filter) - `dstask sync` - Synchronise with git remote ### Task Properties - **Priority**: P0 (highest), P1, P2 (default), P3 (lowest) - **Tags**: Add with `+tag`, remove with `-tag` - **Projects**: Set with `project:name` - **Due dates**: Set with `due:YYYY-MM-DD` - **Status**: open, active, paused, resolved ### Contexts Contexts automatically filter tasks and apply tags to new tasks: ```bash dstask context work dstask add finish report # automatically tagged with +work dstask # shows only work tasks dstask context -- # clear context ``` ### Git Sync Sync your tasks across devices using git: ```bash # Set up sync on first device cd ~/.dstask git remote add origin git push -u origin master # On other devices git clone ~/.dstask # To sync dstask sync ``` ### Templates Create task templates for recurring patterns: ```bash dstask add template +template project:meetings priority:P1 dstask add from-template ``` ## Best Practices - Create contexts for different areas of your life (work, home, etc.) to maintain focus. - Use tags liberally to categorize tasks, but avoid tag explosion. Use 3-5 tags per task at most. - Keep ta 1982 characters elided (( $# == 1 || has_double_dash )) && \ [[ "${subcommand}" =~ ^(done|edit|note|open|remove|start|stop)$ ]] then command dstask show-open $( (( has_double_dash )) && echo "--" ) \ | jq -r '.[] | [.id, .summary] | @tsv' \ | fzf --delimiter='\t' --nth=2 --accept-nth=1 --preview='DSTASK_FAKE_PTY=1 dstask {1} --' \ | xargs -n1 dstask "${subcommand}" return fi fi command dstask "$@" } ``` The wrapper function checks if dstask was called with a subcommand missing the task ID, and if so uses the `show-open` command to get a list of tasks to choose from. `--` can be used to ignore the current context for the fuzzy search. Encryption is not a design goal of dstask. If you want to have your remote repository encrypted, you may consider [git-remote-gcrypt](https://spwhitton.name/tech/code/git-remote-gcrypt/) or [git-crypt](https://github.com/AGWA/git-crypt). Yes. 1. Set a context: 2. Run a modify command without and ID 3. Hit y to confirm to modify all tasks in context This means it's natural to review the tasks that would be modified before modifying by listing all tasks in the current context first, instead of potentially operating blindly by matching tags or numbers. However, dstask can be used as a library -- @botto has started developing a web GUI, specifically to allow task management on-the-go via a smartphone: . It's in early stages but is meaningful as having no smartphone-based control is a blocker for a lot of people. > Has dstask been featured in a magazine? For public repositories, authentication is optional but recommended to avoid rate limits. ### Usage To import issues from a GitHub repository: dstask-import github / You can also import from multiple repositories by running the command multiple times. --- taskwarrior migration --- # Moving from Taskwarrior ## Importing data Please see the [dstask-import tw instructions](dstask-import.md#taskwarrior) to import taskwarrior tasks. ## Using dstask Commands and syntax are deliberately very similar to taskwarrior. Here are the exceptions: * The command is (nearly) always the first argument. Eg, `task eat some add bananas` won't work, but `task add eat some bananas` will. If there's an ID, it can proceed the command but doesn't have to. * Priorities are added by the keywords `P0` `P1` `P2` `P3`. Lower number is more urgent. Default is `P2`. ## Best Practices

- Create contexts for different areas of your life (work, home, etc.) to maintain focus.
- Use tags liberally to categorize tasks, but avoid tag explosion. Use 3-5 tags per task at most.
- Keep task summaries brief. Use the note field for details, checklists, and context.
- Use dstask to track things you might forget, rather than everything. SNR is important. Don't track tasks for the sake of it, and don't track _ideas_. Track ideas separately.
- Spend regular time reviewing tasks. You'll probably find some you've already resolved, and many you've forgotten. The `show-unorganised` command is good for this.
- Try to work through tasks from the top of the list. Dstask sorts by priority then creation date -- the most important tasks are at the top.
- Use `start`/`stop` to mark what you're genuinely working on right now; it makes resuming work faster. Paused tasks will be slightly highlighted, so you won't lose track of them. `show-paused` helps if they start to pile up.
- Keep a [github-style check list](https://help.github.com/en/articles/about-task-lists) in the markdown note of complex or procedural tasks
- Failing to get started working? Start with the smallest task
- Record only required tasks. Track ideas separately, else your task list will grow unboundedly!
- set `DSTASK_CONTEXT` in a `.envrc` per-project repository. With direnv, this allows you to automatically switch context

## Database

The default database location is:

- Linux/macOS: `~/.dstask/`
- Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.dstask`

It can be configured by the environment variable `DSTASK_GIT_REPO`.

## Integration of fuzzy finders

Instead of passing task IDs to commands, a fuzzy finder like [*fzf*](https://github.com/junegunn/fzf) can be used to
search tasks by their summary instead. This is not part of dstask itself, but can be achieved by defining a shell
wrapper like this in your `.bashrc` or `.zshrc`:

```bash
function dstask () {
    local has_double_dash subcommand

    if (( $# == 1 || $# == 2 )); then
        has_double_dash="$( [[ "$1" == "--" || "$2" == "--" ]] && echo "1" || echo "0" )"
        subcommand="$( [[ "$1" == "--" ]] && echo "$2" || echo "$1" )"
        if (( $# == 1 || has_double_dash )) && \
            [[ "${subcommand}" =~ ^(done|edit|note|open|remove|start|stop)$ ]]
        then
            command dstask show-open $( (( has_double_dash )) && echo "--" ) \
                | jq -r '.[] | [.id, .summary] | @tsv' \
                | fzf --delimiter='\t' --nth=2 --accept-nth=1 --preview='DSTASK_FAKE_PTY=1 dstask {1} --' \
                | xargs -n1 dstask "${subcommand}"
            return
        fi
    fi

    command dstask "$@"
}
```

The wrapper function checks if dstask was called with a subcommand missing the task ID, and if so uses the `show-open`
command to get a list of tasks to choose from. `--` can be used to ignore the current context for the fuzzy search. All
other commands are passed directly to dstask.
## FAQ

> Does dstask encrypt tasks?

Encryption is not a design goal of dstask. If you want to have your remote
repository encrypted, you may consider
[git-remote-gcrypt](https://spwhitton.name/tech/code/git-remote-gcrypt/) or
[git-crypt](https://github.com/AGWA/git-crypt). Note that dstask has not been
tested with these tools, nor can any claims be made about the security of the
tools themselves.

> Is it possible to modify more than one task at once with a filter?

Yes.

1. Set a context:
2. Run a modify command without and ID
3. Hit y to confirm to modify all tasks in context

This means it's natural to review the tasks that would be modified before
modifying by listing all tasks in the current context first, instead of
potentially operating blindly by matching tags or numbers.

You can also specify multiple task numbers at one time, as with any other command.

> Is there a GUI or web interface?

Not as part of dstask itself. However, dstask can be used as a library -- @botto
has started developing a web GUI, specifically to allow task management on-the-go

def shell_quote_val(s):

            tags=val or []
            if tags:
                lines.append('tags:')
                for tag in tags: lines.append(f'- {tag}')
            else: lines.append('tags: []')
        elif key in ('subtasks','dependencies'):
            lines.append(f'{key}: []')
        elif key=='notes' and isinstance(val,str) and '\n' in val:
            lines.append('notes: |2-')

def unquote(v):

    if v in ('""', "''"): return ''
    if len(v)>=2 and ((v[0]=='"' and v[-1]=='"') or (v[0]=="'" and v[-1]=="'")):
        try: return json.loads(v) if v[0]=='"' else v[1:-1]
        except Exception: return v[1:-1]
    return v

def parse_task_file(path):
    data={'summary':'','notes':'','tags':[],'project':'','priority':'P2','delegatedto':'','subtasks':[],'dependencies':[],'created':ZERO_TIME,'resolved':ZERO_TIME,'due':ZERO_TIME}
    try: lines=path.read_text().splitlines()
    except Exception: return data
    i=0
    while i < len(lines):
        line=lines[i]
        if not line or line.startswith(' '): i+=1; continue
        if ':' not in line: i+=1; continue
        key, rest=line.split(':',1); rest=rest.lstrip()
        if rest.startswith('|'):
            block=[]; i+=1
            while i<len(lines) and (lines[i].startswith('  ') or lines[i]==''):
                block.append(lines[i][2:] if lines[i].startswith('  ') else '')
                i+=1
            data[key]='\n'.join(block)
            continue
        if key=='tags':
            tags=[]
            if rest.strip() == '[]':
                data['tags']=[]; i+=1; continue
            i+=1
            while i<len(lines) and lines[i].startswith('- '):
                tags.append(unquote(lines[i][2:].strip())); i+=1
            data['tags']=tags; continue
        if rest.strip() == '[]': data[key]=[]
        else: data[key]=unquote(rest)
        i+=1
    return data

class Store:
    def __init__(self, repo):
        self.repo=repo
        self.idmap=load_json_file(meta_file(repo,'ids.bin'), {})
        if not isinstance(self.idmap, dict): self.idmap={}
    def save_ids(self): save_json_file(meta_file(self.repo,'ids.bin'), self.idmap)
    def all_tasks(self, statuses=None):
        tasks=[]; statuses=statuses or STATUSES
        for st in statuses:
            d=self.repo/st
            if not d.exists(): continue
            for p in sorted(d.glob('*.yml')):
                t=parse_task_file(p); u=p.stem
                t['_path']=p; t['uuid']=u; t['status']=st
                if st=='resolved': t['id']=0
                else: t['id']=int(self.idmap.get(u,0) or 0)
                tasks.append(t)
        self.reconcile_ids(tasks)
        return tasks
    def reconcile_ids(self, tasks=None):
        if tasks is None: tasks=self.all_tasks(STATUSES)
        existing={t['uuid'] for t in tasks if t['status'] in ID_STATUSES}
        # Drop mappings for resolved/removed tasks to free IDs.
        self.idmap={u:int(i) for u,i in self.idmap.items() if u in existing and str(i).isdigit()}
        used=set(self.idmap.values())
        need=[t for t in tasks if t['status'] in ID_STATUSES and t['uuid'] not in self.idmap]
        need.sort(key=lambda x:(parse_time_key(x.get('created')), x['uuid']))
        for t in need:
            n=1
            while n in used: n+=1
            self.idmap[t['uuid']]=n; used.add(n); t['id']=n
        for t in tasks:
            if t['status']=='resolved': t['id']=0
            elif t['status'] in ID_STATUSES: t['id']=int(self.idmap.get(t['uuid'],0) or 0)
        self.save_ids()
    def new_id_for_uuid(self, u):
        tasks=self.all_tasks(STATUSES)
        used={t['id'] for t in tasks if t['status'] in ID_STATUSES and t.get('id')}
        n=1
        while n in used: n+=1
        self.idmap[u]=n; self.save_ids(); return n
    def by_id(self, id_, include_templates=True):
        for t in self.all_tasks(STATUSES):
            if t['status'] in (ID_STATUSES if include_templates else OPEN_STATUSES) and t.get('id')==id_:

        return None

def parse_due(s):
    today=date.today()
    if re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', s):
        return s+'T00:00:00Z'
    if re.fullmatch(r'\d{2}-\d{2}', s):
        y=today.year; m,d=map(int,s.split('-'))
        dd=date(y,m,d)
        if dd<today: dd=date(y+1,m,d)
        return dd.isoformat()+'T00:00:00Z'
    if re.fullmatch(r'\d{1,2}', s):
        d=int(s); y=today.year; m=today.month
        dd=date(y,m,d)
        if dd<today:
            if m==12: y+=1; m=1
            else: m+=1
            dd=date(y,m,d)
        return dd.isoformat()+'T00:00:00Z'
    low=s.lower()
    if low=='today': return today.isoformat()+'T00:00:00Z'
    if low=='tomorrow': return (today+timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()+'T00:00:00Z'
    m=re.fullmatch(r'(?:next-)?(monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday|sunday)', low)
    if m:
        target=['monday','tuesday','wednesday','thursday','friday','saturday','sunday'].index(m.group(1))
        delta=(target-today.weekday())%7
        if delta==0: delta=7
        return (today+timedelta(days=delta)).isoformat()+'T00:00:00Z'
    raise ValueError(s)

def parse_query(args, for_add=False, context_args=None):
    args=list(args)
    note=[]
    if '/' in args:
        idx=args.index('/')
        note=args[idx+1:]
        args=args[:idx]
    q={'tags':[], 'anti_tags':[], 'project':None, 'anti_projects':[], 'priority':None, 'text':[], 'due':None, 'template':None, 'note':' '.join(note), 'project_seen':False, 'priority_seen':False}
    def feed(tok, from_context=False):
        if tok=='--': return
        if tok.startswith('template:') and for_add:
            try: q['template']=int(tok.split(':',1)[1]); return
            except Exception: pass
        if tok.startswith('due:'):
            if q['due'] is not None:
                raise RuntimeError('Query should only have one due date')
            val=tok.split(':',1)[1]
            try: q['due']=parse_due(val)
            except Exception:
                raise ValueError(val)
            return
        if tok in PRIOS and not q['priority_seen']:
            q['priority']=tok; q['priority_seen']=True; return
        if tok.startswith('project:') and not q['project_seen']:
            q['project']=tok.split(':',1)[1]; q['project_seen']=True; return
        if tok.startswith('-project:'):
            q['anti_projects'].append(tok.split(':',1)[1]); return
        if tok.startswith('+') and len(tok)>1:
            q['tags'].append(tok[1:]); return
        if tok.startswith('-') and len(tok)>1:
            if for_add:
                # In add syntax, anti-tags do not remove a tag already specified.
                return
            q['anti_tags'].append(tok[1:]); return
        q['text'].append(tok)
    # Context is applied first for adds so explicit project/priority can override where applicable.
    if context_args:
        for tok in context_args: feed(tok, True)
    for tok in args: feed(tok)
    return q

    if 'DSTASK_CONTEXT' in os.environ:
        return shlex.split(os.environ.get('DSTASK_CONTEXT',''))
    state=load_json_file(meta_file(repo,'state.json'), {})
    if isinstance(state,dict): return state.get('context',[]) or []
    return []

def context_string(repo):
    args=context_args(repo)
    # Original prints tags/antitags before project regardless of input order.
    tags=[a for a in args if a.startswith('+')]
    antis=[a for a in args if a.startswith('-') and not a.startswith('-project:')]
    projs=[a for a in args if a.startswith('project:')]
    other=[a for a in args if a not in tags+antis+projs]
    return ' '.join(tags+antis+projs+other)

def filter_tasks(tasks, q=None, ids=None, apply_context_args=None):
    res=[]; ids=set(ids or [])
    combined={'tags':[], 'anti_tags':[], 'project':None, 'anti_projects':[], 'text':[]}
    if apply_context_args:
        cq=parse_query(apply_context_args, for_add=False)
        for k in combined: combined[k]=cq.get(k) if k=='project' else list(cq.get(k,[]))
    if q:
        if q.get('tags'): combined['tags'] += q['tags']
        if q.get('anti_tags'): combined['anti_tags'] += q['anti_tags']
        if q.get('project') is not None: combined['project']=q.get('project')
        if q.get('anti_projects'): combined['anti_projects'] += q['anti_projects']
        if q.get('text'): combined['text'] += q['text']
    text=' '.join(combined.get('text') or []).lower()
    for t in tasks:
        if ids and int(t.get('id',0)) not in ids: continue
        tags=set(t.get('tags') or [])
        if any(x not in tags for x in combined.get('tags') or []): continue
        if any(x in tags for x in combined.get('anti_tags') or []): continue
        if combined.get('project') is not None and t.get('project','') != combined.get('project'): continue
        if any(t.get('project','')==x for x in combined.get('anti_projects') or []): continue
        if text and text not in (t.get('summary','')+' '+t.get('notes','')).lower(): continue
        res.append(t)
    return res

    for ap in q.get('anti_projects') or []:
        if not ap or t.get('project')==ap: t['project']=''
    if q.get('priority'): t['priority']=q['priority']
    if q.get('due'): t['due']=q['due']
    if q.get('note'):
        if t.get('notes'): t['notes'] += '\n' + q['note']
        else: t['notes']=q['note']

def save_task(repo, t, status=None, old_path=None):
    st=status or t.get('status','pending')
    u=t.get('uuid') or str(uuid.uuid4())
    t['uuid']=u; t['status']=st
    d=repo/st; d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    path=d/(u+'.yml')
    if old_path and Path(old_path)!=path:
        try: Path(old_path).unlink()
        except FileNotFoundError: pass
    path.write_text(dump_task(t))
    t['_path']=path
    return path

def commit(repo, msg):
    run_git(repo,['add','-A'])
    diff=run_git(repo,['diff','--cached','--quiet'])
    if diff.returncode==0:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{GREY}No changes detected\n{RESET}")
        return 0
    p=run_git(repo,['commit','-m',msg])
    if p.returncode==0:
        sys.stdout.write(GREY + p.stdout + RESET)
        return 0
    else:
        sys.stdout.write(GREY)
        if p.stdout: sys.stdout.write(p.stdout)
        sys.stderr.write(p.stderr)
        eprint_error('error: failed to commit changes: exit status %d' % p.returncode)
        return 1

def action_context_notice(repo, ignore):
    if ignore: return
    s=context_string(repo)
    if s:
        if 'DSTASK_CONTEXT' in os.environ:
            sys.stdout.write(f"{YELLOW}Active context (set by DSTASK_CONTEXT): {s}{RESET}\n")
        else:
            sys.stdout.write(f"{YELLOW}Active context: {s}{RESET}\n")

def add_like(repo, store, args, status='pending', log=False, ignore_context=False, start_active=False):
    cargs=[] if ignore_context else context_args(repo)
    try: q=parse_query(args, for_add=True, context_args=cargs)
    except RuntimeError as e: eprint_error(str(e)); return 1
    except ValueError as e:
        eprint_error(f"Invalid due date format: {e}\nExpected format: YYYY-MM-DD, MM-DD or DD, relative date like 'next-monday', 'today', etc."); return 1
    tmpl=None
    if q.get('template'):
        tmpl=store.by_id(q['template'], include_templates=True)
        if not tmpl or tmpl.get('status')!='template':
            eprint_error(f"no template with ID {q['template']} exists"); return 1
    if not q.get('text') and not tmpl:
        eprint_error('task description or template required'); return 1
    action_context_notice(repo, ignore_context)
    if tmpl:
        t={k:(list(v) if isinstance(v,list) else v) for k,v in tmpl.items() if not k.startswith('_') and k not in ('uuid','id','status')}
        t['created']=now_iso(); t['resolved']=ZERO_TIME
        # If a text summary is supplied while creating from a template, it replaces the template summary.
        apply_query_to_task(t,q,replace_summary=bool(q.get('text')))
    else:
        t=initial_task(summary=' '.join(q.get('text') or []), notes=q.get('note',''), tags=[], project='', priority='P2', due=ZERO_TIME)
        apply_query_to_task(t,q,replace_summary=False)
    if log:
        t['resolved']=now_iso(); st='resolved'
    else:
        st='active' if start_active else status
    u=str(uuid.uuid4()); t['uuid']=u
    save_task(repo,t,st)
    if st in ID_STATUSES:
        tid=store.new_id_for_uuid(u); t['id']=tid
    else: tid=0
    if log:
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nLogged {t['summary']}\n")
        return commit(repo, f"Logged {t['summary']}")
    elif st=='template':
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nCreated Template {tid}: {t['summary']}\n")
        return commit(repo, f"Created Template {tid}: {t['summary']}")
    elif st=='active':
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nStarted {tid}: {t['summary']}\n")
        return commit(repo, f"Started {tid}: {t['summary']}")
    else:
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nAdded {tid}: {t['summary']}\n")
        return commit(repo, f"Added {tid}: {t['summary']}")

def resolve_ids_from_tokens(tokens):
    return [int(x) for x in tokens if re.fullmatch(r'\d+', x)]

def transition(repo, store, ids, new_status, verb, note_words=None):
    if not ids:
        eprint_error('no ID(s) specified'); return 1
    rc=0
    for id_ in ids:
        t=store.by_id(id_, include_templates=False)
        if not t:
            eprint_error(f"no open task with ID {id_} exists"); return 1
        old=t['status']
        if new_status=='paused' and old!='active':
            eprint_error(f"invalid state transition: {old} -> paused"); return 1
        if new_status=='active' and old=='active':
            # still no filesystem change, but original reports no changes after message
            pass
        if note_words:
            note=' '.join(note_words)
            t['notes']=(t.get('notes','') + '\n' + note) if t.get('notes','') else '\n'+note
        if new_status=='resolved':
            t['resolved']=now_iso()
        old_path=t['_path']
        save_task(repo,t,new_status,old_path=old_path)
        if new_status=='resolved':
            store.idmap.pop(t['uuid'],None); store.save_ids()
        sys.stdout.write(f"\n{verb} {id_}: {t['summary']}\n")
        rc2=commit(repo, f"{verb} {id_}: {t['summary']}")
        if rc2: rc=rc2
    return rc

def remove_cmd(repo, store, ids):
    if not ids: eprint_error('no ID(s) specified'); return 1
    rc=0
    for id_ in ids:
        t=store.by_id(id_, include_templates=True)
        if not t or t.get('status')=='resolved': eprint_error(f"no open task with ID {id_} exists"); return 1
        sys.stdout.write(f"{id_}: {t['summary']}\n")
        try: Path(t['_path']).unlink()
        except FileNotFoundError: pass
        store.idmap.pop(t['uuid'],None); store.save_ids()
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nRemoved: {id_}: {t['summary']}\n")
        rc2=commit(repo, f"Removed: {id_}: {t['summary']}")
        if rc2: rc=rc2
    return rc

def modify_cmd(repo, store, ids, args, ignore_context=False):
    if not args: eprint_error('no operations specified'); return 1
    try: q=parse_query(args, for_add=False)
    except RuntimeError as e: eprint_error(str(e)); return 1
    except ValueError as e: eprint_error(f"Invalid due date format: {e}\nExpected format: YYYY-MM-DD, MM-DD or DD, relative date like 'next-monday', 'today', etc."); return 1
    if not (q.get('tags') or q.get('anti_tags') or q.get('project') is not None or q.get('anti_projects') or q.get('priority') or q.get('due')):
        eprint_error('no operations specified'); return 1
    targets=[]
    if ids:
        for id_ in ids:
            t=store.by_id(id_, include_templates=True)
            if not t or t.get('status')=='resolved': eprint_error(f"no open task with ID {id_} exists"); return 1
            targets.append(t)
    else:
        tasks=store.all_tasks(OPEN_STATUSES)
        cargs=[] if ignore_context else context_args(repo)
        targets=filter_tasks(sort_tasks(tasks), None, None, cargs)
    rc=0
    for t in targets:
        id_=t.get('id',0)
        apply_query_to_task(t,q,replace_summary=False)
        save_task(repo,t,t['status'],old_path=t['_path'])
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nModified {id_}: {t['summary']}\n")
        rc2=commit(repo, f"Modified {id_}: {t['summary']}")
        if rc2: rc=rc2
    return rc

def template_cmd(repo, store, ids, args, ignore_context=False):
    if ids:
        id_=ids[0]
        t=store.by_id(id_, include_templates=True)
        if not t or t.get('status')=='resolved': eprint_error(f"no open task with ID {id_} exists"); return 1
        old=t['_path']; save_task(repo,t,'template',old_path=old)
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nChanged {id_}: {t['summary']} to Template\n")
        return commit(repo, f"Changed {id_}: {t['summary']} to Template")
    # If first arg is a valid ID, convert it; otherwise create a new template.
    if args and re.fullmatch(r'\d+', args[0]):
        t=store.by_id(int(args[0]), include_templates=True)
        if t:
            old=t['_path']; save_task(repo,t,'template',old_path=old)
            sys.stdout.write(f"\nChanged {t['id']}: {t['summary']} to Template\n")
            return commit(repo, f"Changed {t['id']}: {t['summary']} to Template")
    return add_like(repo, store, args, status='template', ignore_context=ignore_context)

def list_cmd(repo, store, cmd, args, ids, ignore_context=False):
    if cmd in ('next','show-open'):
        tasks=store.all_tasks(OPEN_STATUSES)
    elif cmd=='show-active': tasks=store.all_tasks(['active'])
    elif cmd=='show-paused': tasks=store.all_tasks(['paused'])
    elif cmd=='show-resolved': tasks=store.all_tasks(['resolved'])[-1000:]
    elif cmd=='show-templates': tasks=store.all_tasks(['template'])
    elif cmd=='show-unorganised':
        tasks=[t for t in store.all_tasks(OPEN_STATUSES) if not t.get('tags') and not t.get('project')]
        output_tasks(sort_tasks(tasks)); return 0
    else: tasks=store.all_tasks(OPEN_STATUSES)
    q=None
    try: q=parse_query(args, for_add=False) if args else None
    except Exception: q=None
    cargs=[] if ignore_context or cmd in ('show-resolved','show-unorganised') else context_args(repo)
    tasks=filter_tasks(tasks, q, ids, cargs)
    output_tasks(sort_tasks(tasks))
    return 0

def show_tags(repo, store):
    tags=[]
    for t in sort_tasks(store.all_tasks(OPEN_STATUSES)):
        for tag in t.get('tags') or []:
            if tag not in tags: tags.append(tag)
    # The original uses Go map order; keeping deterministic insertion order is close enough.
    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(tags))
    if tags: sys.stdout.write('\n')
    return 0

def show_projects(repo, store):
    groups={}
    for t in store.all_tasks(['pending','active','paused','resolved','template']):
        p=t.get('project','')
        if not p: continue
        g=groups.setdefault(p, {'name':p,'taskCount':0,'resolvedCount':0,'active':False,'created':t.get('created',ZERO_TIME),'resolved':ZERO_TIME,'priority':'P3'})
        g['taskCount']+=1
        if t.get('status')=='resolved':
            g['resolvedCount']+=1
            if t.get('resolved',ZERO_TIME)>g['resolved']: g['resolved']=t.get('resolved',ZERO_TIME)
        if t.get('status')=='active': g['active']=True
        if t.get('created',ZERO_TIME)<g['created']: g['created']=t.get('created',ZERO_TIME)
        if PRIOS.index(t.get('priority','P2')) < PRIOS.index(g['priority']): g['priority']=t.get('priority','P2')
    arr=sorted(groups.values(), key=lambda g:(PRIOS.index(g['priority']), g['created'], g['name']))
    write_json(arr); return 0

def context_cmd(repo, args):
    if not args:
        s=context_string(repo)
        if s: sys.stdout.write(s+'\n')
        return 0
    if len(args)==1 and args[0] in ('none','--'):
        save_json_file(meta_file(repo,'state.json'), {'context':[]}); return 0
    # Keep canonical parsed order for display and future filtering.
    try: q=parse_query(args, for_add=False)
    except Exception: pass
    out=[]
    out += ['+'+x for x in q.get('tags',[])] if 'q' in locals() else [a for a in args if a.startswith('+')]
    out += ['-'+x for x in q.get('anti_tags',[])] if 'q' in locals() else [a for a in args if a.startswith('-')]
    if 'q' in locals() and q.get('project') is not None: out.append('project:'+q.get('project'))
    elif not ('q' in locals()): out += [a for a in args if a.startswith('project:')]
    save_json_file(meta_file(repo,'state.json'), {'context':out})
    return 0

def note_cmd(store, ids):
    if not ids: eprint_error('no ID(s) specified'); return 1
    t=store.by_id(ids[0], include_templates=False)
    if not t: eprint_error(f"no open task with ID {ids[0]} exists"); return 1
    sys.stdout.write(t.get('notes',''))
    return 0

def edit_cmd(repo, store, ids):
    if not ids: eprint_error('no ID(s) specified'); return 1
    t=store.by_id(ids[0], include_templates=True)
    if not t: eprint_error(f"no open task with ID {ids[0]} exists"); return 1
    editor=os.environ.get('EDITOR') or os.environ.get('VISUAL') or 'vi'
    # Edit the YAML file directly, like the original task editor effectively permits.
    p=subprocess.run(editor + ' ' + shlex.quote(str(t['_path'])), shell=True)
    if p.returncode!=0:
        eprint_error('Failed to run $EDITOR'); return 1
    sys.stdout.write(f"\nEdited {ids[0]}: {t['summary']}\n")
    return commit(repo, f"Edited {ids[0]}: {t['summary']}")

def open_cmd(store, ids):
    if not ids: eprint_error('no ID(s) specified'); return 1
    # Use xdg-open/open if available; failure message is the visible behavior on headless CI.
    urls=[]
    for id_ in ids:
        t=store.by_id(id_, include_templates=False)
        if not t: eprint_error(f"no open task with ID {id_} exists"); return 1
        urls += re.findall(r'https?://[^\s)]+', t.get('summary','')+' '+t.get('notes',''))
    opener=shutil.which('xdg-open') or shutil.which('open')
    if not opener or not urls:
        eprint_error('Failed to open browser'); return 1
    ok=True
    for u in urls:
        if subprocess.run([opener,u], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).returncode!=0: ok=False
    if not ok: eprint_error('Failed to open browser'); return 1
    return 0

def git_cmd(repo, args):
    p=run_git(repo,args)
    sys.stdout.write(p.stdout); sys.stderr.write(p.stderr)
    if p.returncode!=0:
        eprint_error('Failed to run git cmd.')
    return p.returncode

def sync_cmd(repo):
    p=run_git(repo,['pull'])
    sys.stdout.write(p.stdout); sys.stderr.write(p.stderr)
    if p.returncode!=0: eprint_error('Failed to run git cmd.'); return p.returncode
    p=run_git(repo,['push'])
    sys.stdout.write(p.stdout); sys.stderr.write(p.stderr)
    if p.returncode!=0: eprint_error('Failed to run git cmd.')
    return p.returncode

def undo_cmd(repo, args):
    n=args[0] if args else '1'
    # Original first shows the commits to be undone; reset on success.
    p=run_git(repo,['log','--oneline',f'HEAD~{n}..'])
    sys.stdout.write(p.stdout); sys.stderr.write(p.stderr)
    if p.returncode!=0: eprint_error('Failed to run git cmd.'); return p.returncode
    p=run_git(repo,['reset','--hard',f'HEAD~{n}'])
    sys.stdout.write(p.stdout); sys.stderr.write(p.stderr)
    if p.returncode!=0: eprint_error('Failed to run git cmd.')
    return p.returncode

def completions(repo, args):
    store=Store(repo)
    comps=["next","add","rm","remove","template","log","start","note","notes","stop","done","resolve","context","modify","edit","undo","sync","open","git","show-next","show-projects","show-tags","show-active","show-paused","show-open","show-resolved","show-templates","show-unorganised","bash-completion","fish-completion","zsh-completion","help","version","P0","P1","P2","P3"]
    tasks=store.all_tasks(STATUSES)
    projects=[]; tags=[]
    for t in tasks:
        if t.get('project') and t['project'] not in projects: projects.append(t['project'])
        for tag in t.get('tags') or []:
            if tag not in tags: tags.append(tag)
    comps += ['project:'+p for p in projects] + ['-project:'+p for p in projects] + ['+'+t for t in tags] + ['-'+t for t in tags]
    prefix=args[-1] if args else ''
    if prefix in ('dstask','task'): prefix=''
    out=[c for c in comps if not prefix or c.startswith(prefix)]
    if out: sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(out)+'\n')
    return 0

def parse_command(argv):
    ignore=False
    args=[]
    for a in argv:
        if a=='--': ignore=True
        else: args.append(a)
    if not args: return 'next', [], [], ignore
    # command first
    if args[0] in COMMANDS:
        cmd=ALIASES.get(args[0],args[0]); rest=args[1:]
        ids=resolve_ids_from_tokens(rest) if cmd not in ('add','log','context','git','help','_completions') else []
        if cmd in ('done','stop','start','remove','modify','edit','note','open','template'):
            rest=[x for x in rest if not re.fullmatch(r'\d+',x)]
        return cmd, ids, rest, ignore
    # ids before command
    lead=[]; i=0
    while i<len(args) and re.fullmatch(r'\d+', args[i]):
        lead.append(int(args[i])); i+=1
    if i<len(args) and args[i] in COMMANDS:
        cmd=ALIASES.get(args[i],args[i]); rest=args[i+1:]
        more=resolve_ids_from_tokens(rest) if cmd in ('done','stop','start','remove','modify','edit','note','open') else []
        if more: rest=[x for x in rest if not re.fullmatch(r'\d+',x)]
        return cmd, lead+more, rest, ignore
    # default list: numeric tokens are ID filters, the rest are query text/filter.
    ids=resolve_ids_from_tokens(args)
    rest=[x for x in args if not re.fullmatch(r'\d+',x)]
    return 'next', ids, rest, ignore

def main(argv):
    if argv and argv[0]=='version':
        sys.stdout.write('Version: Unknown\nGit commit: Unknown\nBuild date: Unknown\n'); return 0
    if argv and argv[0]=='help':
        if len(argv)>1 and ALIASES.get(argv[1],argv[1]) in HELPS:
            sys.stderr.write(HELPS[ALIASES.get(argv[1],argv[1])])
        elif len(argv)>1 and argv[1]=='next': sys.stderr.write(HELPS['next'])
        else: sys.stderr.write(MAIN_HELP)
        return 0
    if argv and argv[0]=='bash-completion': sys.stdout.write(BASH_COMPLETION); return 0
    if argv and argv[0]=='fish-completion': sys.stdout.write(FISH_COMPLETION); return 0
    if argv and argv[0]=='zsh-completion': sys.stdout.write(ZSH_COMPLETION); return 0
    repo=repo_path()
    ensure_repo(repo, init_output=True)
    store=Store(repo)
    cmd, ids, rest, ignore=parse_command(argv)
    if cmd=='version': sys.stdout.write('Version: Unknown\nGit commit: Unknown\nBuild date: Unknown\n'); return 0
    if cmd=='help': sys.stderr.write(MAIN_HELP); return 0
    if cmd=='_completions': return completions(repo, rest)
    if cmd in ('next','show-open','show-active','show-paused','show-resolved','show-templates','show-unorganised'):
        return list_cmd(repo,store,cmd,rest,ids,ignore)
    if cmd=='show-tags': return show_tags(repo,store)
    if cmd=='show-projects': return show_projects(repo,store)
    if cmd=='add': return add_like(repo,store,rest,ignore_context=ignore)
    if cmd=='log': return add_like(repo,store,rest,log=True,ignore_context=ignore)
    if cmd=='start':
        if ids: return transition(repo,store,ids,'active','Started')
        if rest: return add_like(repo,store,rest,start_active=True,ignore_context=ignore)
        eprint_error('nothing to do -- specify an ID or describe a task'); return 1
    if cmd=='stop': return transition(repo,store,ids,'paused','Stopped',rest)
    if cmd=='done': return transition(repo,store,ids,'resolved','Resolved',rest)
    if cmd=='remove': return remove_cmd(repo,store,ids)
    if cmd=='modify': return modify_cmd(repo,store,ids,rest,ignore_context=ignore)
    if cmd=='template': return template_cmd(repo,store,ids,rest,ignore_context=ignore)
    if cmd=='context': return context_cmd(repo,rest)
    if cmd=='note': return note_cmd(store,ids)
    if cmd=='edit': return edit_cmd(repo,store,ids)
    if cmd=='open': return open_cmd(store,ids)
    if cmd=='git': return git_cmd(repo,rest)
    if cmd=='sync': return sync_cmd(repo)
    if cmd=='undo': return undo_cmd(repo,rest)
    # Unknown commands are interpreted as default filters.
    return list_cmd(repo,store,'next',argv,[],False)

if __name__=='__main__':
    try:
        sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
    except BrokenPipeError:
        try: sys.stdout.close()
        except Exception: pass
        sys.exit(0)

def eprint_error(msg):

def repo_path():

        return Path(os.environ['DSTASK_GIT_REPO']).expanduser()

def run_git(repo, args, capture=True):
    if capture:
        return subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(repo)] + args, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(repo)] + args)

def ensure_repo(repo, init_output=True):
    repo.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if not (repo/'.git').exists():
        # Let git produce its normal initialisation chatter.
        p = subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(repo),'init'], text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        if init_output:
            sys.stdout.write(p.stdout)
            sys.stderr.write(p.stderr)
            sys.stdout.write("\nAdd a remote repository with:\n\n\tdstask git remote add origin <repo>\n\n")
    for d in STATUSES:
        (repo/d).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (repo/'.git'/'dstask').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def now_iso():
    ns = time.time_ns()
    sec = ns//1_000_000_000
    n = ns%1_000_000_000
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(sec, timezone.utc)
    return dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S') + ('.%09dZ' % n).rstrip('0').rstrip('.') + 'Z' if False else dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S') + '.%09dZ' % n

def parse_time_key(s):
    if not s or s == ZERO_TIME:
        return ''
    return s

def shell_quote_val(s):
    if s == "": return '""'
    if '\n' in s: return None
    # Match the plain style used by the original for common values.
    if re.search(r'^\s|\s$|[:#]\s|[\[\]{}&,*!|>\'"%@`]', s):
        return json.dumps(s)
    return s

def dump_task(t):
    lines=[]
    for key in ['summary','notes','tags','project','priority','delegatedto','subtasks','dependencies','created','resolved','due']:
        val=t.get(key)
        if key=='tags':
            tags=val or []
            if tags:
                lines.append('tags:')
                for tag in tags: lines.append(f'- {tag}')
            else: lines.append('tags: []')
        elif key in ('subtasks','dependencies'):
            lines.append(f'{key}: []')
        elif key=='notes' and isinstance(val,str) and '\n' in val:
            lines.append('notes: |2-')
            for ln in val.split('\n'):
                lines.append('  '+ln)
        else:
            q=shell_quote_val(str(val if val is not None else ''))
            if q is None:
                lines.append(f'{key}: |2-')
                for ln in str(val).split('\n'): lines.append('  '+ln)
            else:
                lines.append(f'{key}: {q}')
    return '\n'.join(lines)+'\n'

def unquote(v):
    v=v.strip()
    if v in ('""', "''"): return ''
    if len(v)>=2 and ((v[0]=='"' and v[-1]=='"') or (v[0]=="'" and v[-1]=="'")):
        try: return json.loads(v) if v[0]=='"' else v[1:-1]
        except Exception: return v[1:-1]
    return v

def parse_task_file(path):
    data={'summary':'','notes':'','tags':[],'project':'','priority':'P2','delegatedto':'','subtasks':[],'dependencies':[],'created':ZERO_TIME,'resolved':ZERO_TIME,'due':ZERO_TIME}
    try: lines=path.read_text().splitlines()
    except Exception: return data
    i=0
    while i < len(lines):
        line=lines[i]
        if not line or line.startswith(' '): i+=1; continue
        if ':' not in line: i+=1; continue
        key, rest=line.split(':',1); rest=rest.lstrip()
        if rest.startswith('|'):
            block=[]; i+=1
            while i<len(lines) and (lines[i].startswith('  ') or lines[i]==''):
                block.append(lines[i][2:] if lines[i].startswith('  ') else '')
                i+=1
            data[key]='\n'.join(block)
            continue
        if key=='tags':
            tags=[]
            if rest.strip() == '[]':
                data['tags']=[]; i+=1; continue
            i+=1
            while i<len(lines) and lines[i].startswith('- '):
                tags.append(unquote(lines[i][2:].strip())); i+=1
            data['tags']=tags; continue
        if rest.strip() == '[]': data[key]=[]
        else: data[key]=unquote(rest)
        i+=1
    return data

class Store:
    def __init__(self, repo):
        self.repo=repo
        self.idmap=load_json_file(meta_file(repo,'ids.bin'), {})
        if not isinstance(self.idmap, dict): self.idmap={}
    def save_ids(self): save_json_file(meta_file(self.repo,'ids.bin'), self.idmap)
    def all_tasks(self, statuses=None):
        tasks=[]; statuses=statuses or STATUSES
        for st in statuses:
            d=self.repo/st
            if not d.exists(): continue
            for p in sorted(d.glob('*.yml')):
                t=parse_task_file(p); u=p.stem
                t['_path']=p; t['uuid']=u; t['status']=st
                if st=='resolved': t['id']=0
                else: t['id']=int(self.idmap.get(u,0) or 0)
                tasks.append(t)
        self.reconcile_ids(tasks)
        return tasks
    def reconcile_ids(self, tasks=None):
        if tasks is None: tasks=self.all_tasks(STATUSES)
        existing={t['uuid'] for t in tasks if t['status'] in ID_STATUSES}
        # Drop mappings for resolved/removed tasks to free IDs.
        self.idmap={u:int(i) for u,i in self.idmap.items() if u in existing and str(i).isdigit()}
        used=set(self.idmap.values())
        need=[t for t in tasks if t['status'] in ID_STATUSES and t['uuid'] not in self.idmap]
        need.sort(key=lambda x:(parse_time_key(x.get('created')), x['uuid']))
        for t in need:
            n=1
            while n in used: n+=1
            self.idmap[t['uuid']]=n; used.add(n); t['id']=n
        for t in tasks:
            if t['status']=='resolved': t['id']=0
            elif t['status'] in ID_STATUSES: t['id']=int(self.idmap.get(t['uuid'],0) or 0)
        self.save_ids()
    def new_id_for_uuid(self, u):
        tasks=self.all_tasks(STATUSES)
        used={t['id'] for t in tasks if t['status'] in ID_STATUSES and t.get('id')}
        n=1
        while n in used: n+=1
        self.idmap[u]=n; self.save_ids(); return n
    def by_id(self, id_, include_templates=True):
        for t in self.all_tasks(STATUSES):
            if t['status'] in (ID_STATUSES if include_templates else OPEN_STATUSES) and t.get('id')==id_:
                return t
        return None

def parse_due(s):
    today=date.today()
    if re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', s):
        return s+'T00:00:00Z'
    if re.fullmatch(r'\d{2}-\d{2}', s):
        y=today.year; m,d=map(int,s.split('-'))
        dd=date(y,m,d)
        if dd<today: dd=date(y+1,m,d)
        return dd.isoformat()+'T00:00:00Z'
    if re.fullmatch(r'\d{1,2}', s):
        d=int(s); y=today.year; m=today.month
        dd=date(y,m,d)
        if dd<today:
            if m==12: y+=1; m=1
            else: m+=1
            dd=date(y,m,d)
        return dd.isoformat()+'T00:00:00Z'
    low=s.lower()
    if low=='today': return today.isoformat()+'T00:00:00Z'
    if low=='tomorrow': return (today+timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()+'T00:00:00Z'
    m=re.fullmatch(r'(?:next-)?(monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday|sunday)', low)
    if m:
        target=['monday','tuesday','wednesday','thursday','friday','saturday','sunday'].index(m.group(1))
        delta=(target-today.weekday())%7
        if delta==0: delta=7
        return (today+timedelta(days=delta)).isoformat()+'T00:00:00Z'
    raise ValueError(s)

def parse_query(args, for_add=False, context_args=None):
    args=list(args)
    note=[]
    if '/' in args:
        idx=args.index('/')
        note=args[idx+1:]
        args=args[:idx]
    q={'tags':[], 'anti_tags':[], 'project':None, 'anti_projects':[], 'priority':None, 'text':[], 'due':None, 'template':None, 'note':' '.join(note), 'project_seen':False, 'priority_seen':False}
    def feed(tok, from_context=False):
        if tok=='--': return
        if tok.startswith('template:') and for_add:
            try: q['template']=int(tok.split(':',1)[1]); return
            except Exception: pass
        if tok.startswith('due:'):
            if q['due'] is not None:
                raise RuntimeError('Query should only have one due date')
            val=tok.split(':',1)[1]
            try: q['due']=parse_due(val)
            except Exception:
                raise ValueError(val)
            return
        if tok in PRIOS and not q['priority_seen']:
            q['priority']=tok; q['priority_seen']=True; return
        if tok.startswith('project:') and not q['project_seen']:
            q['project']=tok.split(':',1)[1]; q['project_seen']=True; return
        if tok.startswith('-project:'):
            q['anti_projects'].append(tok.split(':',1)[1]); return
        if tok.startswith('+') and len(tok)>1:
            q['tags'].append(tok[1:]); return
        if tok.startswith('-') and len(tok)>1:
            if for_add:
                # In add syntax, anti-tags do not remove a tag already specified.
                return
            q['anti_tags'].append(tok[1:]); return
        q['text'].append(tok)
    # Context is applied first for adds so explicit project/priority can override where applicable.
    if context_args:
        for tok in context_args: feed(tok, True)
    for tok in args: feed(tok)
    return q

def context_args(repo):
    if 'DSTASK_CONTEXT' in os.environ:
        return shlex.split(os.environ.get('DSTASK_CONTEXT',''))
    state=load_json_file(meta_file(repo,'state.json'), {})
    if isinstance(state,dict): return state.get('context',[]) or []
    return []

def context_string(repo):
    args=context_args(repo)
    # Original prints tags/antitags before project regardless of input order.
    tags=[a for a in args if a.startswith('+')]
    antis=[a for a in args if a.startswith('-') and not a.startswith('-project:')]
    projs=[a for a in args if a.startswith('project:')]
    other=[a for a in args if a not in tags+antis+projs]
    return ' '.join(tags+antis+projs+other)

def filter_tasks(tasks, q=None, ids=None, apply_context_args=None):
    res=[]; ids=set(ids or [])
    combined={'tags':[], 'anti_tags':[], 'project':None, 'anti_projects':[], 'text':[]}
    if apply_context_args:
        cq=parse_query(apply_context_args, for_add=False)
        for k in combined: combined[k]=cq.get(k) if k=='project' else list(cq.get(k,[]))
    if q:
        if q.get('tags'): combined['tags'] += q['tags']
        if q.get('anti_tags'): combined['anti_tags'] += q['anti_tags']
        if q.get('project') is not None: combined['project']=q.get('project')
        if q.get('anti_projects'): combined['anti_projects'] += q['anti_projects']
        if q.get('text'): combined['text'] += q['text']
    text=' '.join(combined.get('text') or []).lower()
    for t in tasks:
        if ids and int(t.get('id',0)) not in ids: continue
        tags=set(t.get('tags') or [])
        if any(x not in tags for x in combined.get('tags') or []): continue
        if any(x in tags for x in combined.get('anti_tags') or []): continue
        if combined.get('project') is not None and t.get('project','') != combined.get('project'): continue
        if any(t.get('project','')==x for x in combined.get('anti_projects') or []): continue
        if text and text not in (t.get('summary','')+' '+t.get('notes','')).lower(): continue
        res.append(t)
    return res

def sort_tasks(tasks):
    return sorted(tasks, key=lambda t:(PRIOS.index(t.get('priority','P2')) if t.get('priority','P2') in PRIOS else 2, parse_time_key(t.get('created')), t.get('uuid','')))

def initial_task(summary='', notes='', tags=None, project='', priority='P2', due=ZERO_TIME):
    return {'summary':summary,'notes':notes,'tags':tags or [],'project':project or '', 'priority':priority or 'P2', 'delegatedto':'', 'subtasks':[], 'dependencies':[], 'created':now_iso(), 'resolved':ZERO_TIME, 'due':due or ZERO_TIME}

def apply_query_to_task(t, q, replace_summary=False):
    if q.get('text') and replace_summary:
        t['summary']=' '.join(q['text'])
    for tag in q.get('tags') or []:
        if tag not in t['tags']: t['tags'].append(tag)
    for tag in q.get('anti_tags') or []:
        t['tags']=[x for x in t['tags'] if x!=tag]
    if q.get('project') is not None and q.get('project')!='':
        t['project']=q.get('project')
    for ap in q.get('anti_projects') or []:
        if not ap or t.get('project')==ap: t['project']=''
    if q.get('priority'): t['priority']=q['priority']
    if q.get('due'): t['due']=q['due']
    if q.get('note'):
        if t.get('notes'): t['notes'] += '\n' + q['note']
        else: t['notes']=q['note']

    st=status or t.get('status','pending')
    u=t.get('uuid') or str(uuid.uuid4())
    t['uuid']=u; t['status']=st
    d=repo/st; d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    path=d/(u+'.yml')
    if old_path and Path(old_path)!=path:
        try: Path(old_path).unlink()
        except FileNotFoundError: pass
    path.write_text(dump_task(t))
    t['_path']=path
    return path

def commit(repo, msg):
    run_git(repo,['add','-A'])
    diff=run_git(repo,['diff','--cached','--quiet'])
    if diff.returncode==0:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{GREY}No changes detected\n{RESET}")
        return 0
    p=run_git(repo,['commit','-m',msg])
    if p.returncode==0:
        sys.stdout.write(GREY + p.stdout + RESET)
        return 0
    else:
        sys.stdout.write(GREY)
        if p.stdout: sys.stdout.write(p.stdout)
        sys.stderr.write(p.stderr)
        eprint_error('error: failed to commit changes: exit status %d' % p.returncode)
        return 1

    try: q=parse_query(args, for_add=True, context_args=cargs)
    except RuntimeError as e: eprint_error(str(e)); return 1
    except ValueError as e:
        eprint_error(f"Invalid due date format: {e}\nExpected format: YYYY-MM-DD, MM-DD or DD, relative date like 'next-monday', 'today', etc."); return 1
    tmpl=None
    if q.get('template'):
        tmpl=store.by_id(q['template'], include_templates=True)
        if not tmpl or tmpl.get('status')!='template':
            eprint_error(f"no template with ID {q['template']} exists"); return 1
    if not q.get('text') and not tmpl:
        eprint_error('task description or template required'); return 1
    action_context_notice(repo, ignore_context)
    if tmpl:
        t={k:(list(v) if isinstance(v,list) else v) for k,v in tmpl.items() if not k.startswith('_') and k not in ('uuid','id','status')}
        t['created']=now_iso(); t['resolved']=ZERO_TIME
        # If a text summary is supplied while creating from a template, it replaces the template summary.
        apply_query_to_task(t,q,replace_summary=bool(q.get('text')))
    else:
        t=initial_task(summary=' '.join(q.get('text') or []), notes=q.get('note',''), tags=[], project='', priority='P2', due=ZERO_TIME)
        apply_query_to_task(t,q,replace_summary=False)
    if log:
        t['resolved']=now_iso(); st='resolved'
    else:
        st='active' if start_active else status
    u=str(uuid.uuid4()); t['uuid']=u
    save_task(repo,t,st)
    if st in ID_STATUSES:
        tid=store.new_id_for_uuid(u); t['id']=tid
    else: tid=0
    if log:
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nLogged {t['summary']}\n")
        return commit(repo, f"Logged {t['summary']}")
    elif st=='template':
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nCreated Template {tid}: {t['summary']}\n")
        return commit(repo, f"Created Template {tid}: {t['summary']}")
    elif st=='active':
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nStarted {tid}: {t['summary']}\n")
        return commit(repo, f"Started {tid}: {t['summary']}")
    else:
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nAdded {tid}: {t['summary']}\n")
        return commit(repo, f"Added {tid}: {t['summary']}")

def resolve_ids_from_tokens(tokens):
    return [int(x) for x in tokens if re.fullmatch(r'\d+', x)]

def transition(repo, store, ids, new_status, verb, note_words=None):
    if not ids:
        eprint_error('no ID(s) specified'); return 1
    rc=0
    for id_ in ids:
        t=store.by_id(id_, include_templates=False)
        if not t:
            eprint_error(f"no open task with ID {id_} exists"); return 1
        old=t['status']
        if new_status=='paused' and old!='active':
            eprint_error(f"invalid state transition: {old} -> paused"); return 1
        if new_status=='active' and old=='active':
            # still no filesystem change, but original reports no changes after message
            pass
        if note_words:
            note=' '.join(note_words)
            t['notes']=(t.get('notes','') + '\n' + note) if t.get('notes','') else '\n'+note
        if new_status=='resolved':
            t['resolved']=now_iso()
        old_path=t['_path']
        save_task(repo,t,new_status,old_path=old_path)
        if new_status=='resolved':
            store.idmap.pop(t['uuid'],None); store.save_ids()
        sys.stdout.write(f"\n{verb} {id_}: {t['summary']}\n")
        rc2=commit(repo, f"{verb} {id_}: {t['summary']}")
        if rc2: rc=rc2
    return rc

def remove_cmd(repo, store, ids):
    if not ids: eprint_error('no ID(s) specified'); return 1
    rc=0
    for id_ in ids:
        t=store.by_id(id_, include_templates=True)
        if not t or t.get('status')=='resolved': eprint_error(f"no open task with ID {id_} exists"); return 1
        sys.stdout.write(f"{id_}: {t['summary']}\n")
        try: Path(t['_path']).unlink()
        except FileNotFoundError: pass
        store.idmap.pop(t['uuid'],None); store.save_ids()
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nRemoved: {id_}: {t['summary']}\n")
        rc2=commit(repo, f"Removed: {id_}: {t['summary']}")
        if rc2: rc=rc2
    return rc

def modify_cmd(repo, store, ids, args, ignore_context=False):
    if not args: eprint_error('no operations specified'); return 1
    try: q=parse_query(args, for_add=False)
    except RuntimeError as e: eprint_error(str(e)); return 1
    except ValueError as e: eprint_error(f"Invalid due date format: {e}\nExpected format: YYYY-MM-DD, MM-DD or DD, relative date like 'next-monday', 'today', etc."); return 1
    if not (q.get('tags') or q.get('anti_tags') or q.get('project') is not None or q.get('anti_projects') or q.get('priority') or q.get('due')):
        eprint_error('no operations specified'); return 1
    targets=[]
    if ids:
        for id_ in ids:
            t=store.by_id(id_, include_templates=True)
            if not t or t.get('status')=='resolved': eprint_error(f"no open task with ID {id_} exists"); return 1
            targets.append(t)
    else:
        tasks=store.all_tasks(OPEN_STATUSES)
        cargs=[] if ignore_context else context_args(repo)
        targets=filter_tasks(sort_tasks(tasks), None, None, cargs)
    rc=0
    for t in targets:
        id_=t.get('id',0)
        apply_query_to_task(t,q,replace_summary=False)
        save_task(repo,t,t['status'],old_path=t['_path'])
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nModified {id_}: {t['summary']}\n")
        rc2=commit(repo, f"Modified {id_}: {t['summary']}")
        if rc2: rc=rc2
    return rc

def template_cmd(repo, store, ids, args, ignore_context=False):
    if ids:
        id_=ids[0]
        t=store.by_id(id_, include_templates=True)
        if not t or t.get('status')=='resolved': eprint_error(f"no open task with ID {id_} exists"); return 1
        old=t['_path']; save_task(repo,t,'template',old_path=old)
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nChanged {id_}: {t['summary']} to Template\n")
        return commit(repo, f"Changed {id_}: {t['summary']} to Template")
    # If first arg is a valid ID, convert it; otherwise create a new template.
    if args and re.fullmatch(r'\d+', args[0]):
        t=store.by_id(int(args[0]), include_templates=True)
        if t:
            old=t['_path']; save_task(repo,t,'template',old_path=old)
            sys.stdout.write(f"\nChanged {t['id']}: {t['summary']} to Template\n")
            return commit(repo, f"Changed {t['id']}: {t['summary']} to Template")
    return add_like(repo, store, args, status='template', ignore_context=ignore_context)

def list_cmd(repo, store, cmd, args, ids, ignore_context=False):
    if cmd in ('next','show-open'):
        tasks=store.all_tasks(OPEN_STATUSES)
    elif cmd=='show-active': tasks=store.all_tasks(['active'])
    elif cmd=='show-paused': tasks=store.all_tasks(['paused'])
    elif cmd=='show-resolved': tasks=store.all_tasks(['resolved'])[-1000:]
    elif cmd=='show-templates': tasks=store.all_tasks(['template'])
    elif cmd=='show-unorganised':
        tasks=[t for t in store.all_tasks(OPEN_STATUSES) if not t.get('tags') and not t.get('project')]
        output_tasks(sort_tasks(tasks)); return 0
    else: tasks=store.all_tasks(OPEN_STATUSES)
    q=None
    try: q=parse_query(args, for_add=False) if args else None
    except Exception: q=None
    cargs=[] if ignore_context or cmd in ('show-resolved','show-unorganised') else context_args(repo)
    tasks=filter_tasks(tasks, q, ids, cargs)
    output_tasks(sort_tasks(tasks))
    return 0

def show_tags(repo, store):
    tags=[]
    for t in sort_tasks(store.all_tasks(OPEN_STATUSES)):
        for tag in t.get('tags') or []:
            if tag not in tags: tags.append(tag)
    # The original uses Go map order; keeping deterministic insertion order is close enough.
    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(tags))
    if tags: sys.stdout.write('\n')
    return 0

def show_projects(repo, store):
    groups={}
    for t in store.all_tasks(['pending','active','paused','resolved','template']):
        p=t.get('project','')
        if not p: continue
        g=groups.setdefault(p, {'name':p,'taskCount':0,'resolvedCount':0,'active':False,'created':t.get('created',ZERO_TIME),'resolved':ZERO_TIME,'priority':'P3'})
        g['taskCount']+=1
        if t.get('status')=='resolved':
            g['resolvedCount']+=1
            if t.get('resolved',ZERO_TIME)>g['resolved']: g['resolved']=t.get('resolved',ZERO_TIME)
        if t.get('status')=='active': g['active']=True
        if t.get('created',ZERO_TIME)<g['created']: g['created']=t.get('created',ZERO_TIME)
        if PRIOS.index(t.get('priority','P2')) < PRIOS.index(g['priority']): g['priority']=t.get('priority','P2')
    arr=sorted(groups.values(), key=lambda g:(PRIOS.index(g['priority']), g['created'], g['name']))
    write_json(arr); return 0

def context_cmd(repo, args):
    if not args:
        s=context_string(repo)
        if s: sys.stdout.write(s+'\n')
        return 0
    if len(args)==1 and args[0] in ('none','--'):
        save_json_file(meta_file(repo,'state.json'), {'context':[]}); return 0
    # Keep canonical parsed order for display and future filtering.
    try: q=parse_query(args, for_add=False)
    except Exception: pass
    out=[]
    out += ['+'+x for x in q.get('tags',[])] if 'q' in locals() else [a for a in args if a.startswith('+')]
    out += ['-'+x for x in q.get('anti_tags',[])] if 'q' in locals() else [a for a in args if a.startswith('-')]
    if 'q' in locals() and q.get('project') is not None: out.append('project:'+q.get('project'))
    elif not ('q' in locals()): out += [a for a in args if a.startswith('project:')]
    save_json_file(meta_file(repo,'state.json'), {'context':out})
    return 0

def note_cmd(store, ids):
    if not ids: eprint_error('no ID(s) specified'); return 1
    t=store.by_id(ids[0], include_templates=False)
    if not t: eprint_error(f"no open task with ID {ids[0]} exists"); return 1
    sys.stdout.write(t.get('notes',''))
    return 0

def edit_cmd(repo, store, ids):
    if not ids: eprint_error('no ID(s) specified'); return 1
    t=store.by_id(ids[0], include_templates=True)
    if not t: eprint_error(f"no open task with ID {ids[0]} exists"); return 1
    editor=os.environ.get('EDITOR') or os.environ.get('VISUAL') or 'vi'
    # Edit the YAML file directly, like the original task editor effectively permits.
    p=subprocess.run(editor + ' ' + shlex.quote(str(t['_path'])), shell=True)
    if p.returncode!=0:
        eprint_error('Failed to run $EDITOR'); return 1
    sys.stdout.write(f"\nEdited {ids[0]}: {t['summary']}\n")
    return commit(repo, f"Edited {ids[0]}: {t['summary']}")

def open_cmd(store, ids):
    if not ids: eprint_error('no ID(s) specified'); return 1
    # Use xdg-open/open if available; failure message is the visible behavior on headless CI.
    urls=[]
    for id_ in ids:
        t=store.by_id(id_, include_templates=False)
        if not t: eprint_error(f"no open task with ID {id_} exists"); return 1
        urls += re.findall(r'https?://[^\s)]+', t.get('summary','')+' '+t.get('notes',''))
    opener=shutil.which('xdg-open') or shutil.which('open')
    if not opener or not urls:
        eprint_error('Failed to open browser'); return 1
    ok=True
    for u in urls:
        if subprocess.run([opener,u], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).returncode!=0: ok=False
    if not ok: eprint_error('Failed to open browser'); return 1
    return 0

def git_cmd(repo, args):
    p=run_git(repo,args)
    sys.stdout.write(p.stdout); sys.stderr.write(p.stderr)
    if p.returncode!=0:
        eprint_error('Failed to run git cmd.')
    return p.returncode

def sync_cmd(repo):
    p=run_git(repo,['pull'])
    sys.stdout.write(p.stdout); sys.stderr.write(p.stderr)
    if p.returncode!=0: eprint_error('Failed to run git cmd.'); return p.returncode
    p=run_git(repo,['push'])
    sys.stdout.write(p.stdout); sys.stderr.write(p.stderr)
    if p.returncode!=0: eprint_error('Failed to run git cmd.')
    return p.returncode

def undo_cmd(repo, args):
    n=args[0] if args else '1'
    # Original first shows the commits to be undone; reset on success.
    p=run_git(repo,['log','--oneline',f'HEAD~{n}..'])
    sys.stdout.write(p.stdout); sys.stderr.write(p.stderr)
    if p.returncode!=0: eprint_error('Failed to run git cmd.'); return p.returncode
    p=run_git(repo,['reset','--hard',f'HEAD~{n}'])
    sys.stdout.write(p.stdout); sys.stderr.write(p.stderr)
    if p.returncode!=0: eprint_error('Failed to run git cmd.')
    return p.returncode

def completions(repo, args):
    store=Store(repo)
    comps=["next","add","rm","remove","template","log","start","note","notes","stop","done","resolve","context","modify","edit","undo","sync","open","git","show-next","show-projects","show-tags","show-active","show-paused","show-open","show-resolved","show-templates","show-unorganised","bash-completion","fish-completion","zsh-completion","help","version","P0","P1","P2","P3"]
    tasks=store.all_tasks(STATUSES)
    projects=[]; tags=[]
    for t in tasks:
        if t.get('project') and t['project'] not in projects: projects.append(t['project'])
        for tag in t.get('tags') or []:
            if tag not in tags: tags.append(tag)
    comps += ['project:'+p for p in projects] + ['-project:'+p for p in projects] + ['+'+t for t in tags] + ['-'+t for t in tags]
    prefix=args[-1] if args else ''
    if prefix in ('dstask','task'): prefix=''
    out=[c for c in comps if not prefix or c.startswith(prefix)]
    if out: sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(out)+'\n')
    return 0

def parse_command(argv):
    ignore=False
    args=[]
    for a in argv:
        if a=='--': ignore=True
        else: args.append(a)
    if not args: return 'next', [], [], ignore
    # command first
    if args[0] in COMMANDS:
        cmd=ALIASES.get(args[0],args[0]); rest=args[1:]
        ids=resolve_ids_from_tokens(rest) if cmd not in ('add','log','context','git','help','_completions') else []
        if cmd in ('done','stop','start','remove','modify','edit','note','open','template'):
            rest=[x for x in rest if not re.fullmatch(r'\d+',x)]
        return cmd, ids, rest, ignore
    # ids before command
    lead=[]; i=0
    while i<len(args) and re.fullmatch(r'\d+', args[i]):
        lead.append(int(args[i])); i+=1
    if i<len(args) and args[i] in COMMANDS:
        cmd=ALIASES.get(args[i],args[i]); rest=args[i+1:]
        more=resolve_ids_from_tokens(rest) if cmd in ('done','stop','start','remove','modify','edit','note','open') else []
        if more: rest=[x for x in rest if not re.fullmatch(r'\d+',x)]
        return cmd, lead+more, rest, ignore
    # default list: numeric tokens are ID filters, the rest are query text/filter.
    ids=resolve_ids_from_tokens(args)
    rest=[x for x in args if not re.fullmatch(r'\d+',x)]
    return 'next', ids, rest, ignore

def main(argv):
    if argv and argv[0]=='version':
        sys.stdout.write('Version: Unknown\nGit commit: Unknown\nBuild date: Unknown\n'); return 0
    if argv and argv[0]=='help':
        if len(argv)>1 and ALIASES.get(argv[1],argv[1]) in HELPS:
            sys.stderr.write(HELPS[ALIASES.get(argv[1],argv[1])])
        elif len(argv)>1 and argv[1]=='next': sys.stderr.write(HELPS['next'])
        else: sys.stderr.write(MAIN_HELP)
        return 0
    if argv and argv[0]=='bash-completion': sys.stdout.write(BASH_COMPLETION); return 0
    if argv and argv[0]=='fish-completion': sys.stdout.write(FISH_COMPLETION); return 0
    if argv and argv[0]=='zsh-completion': sys.stdout.write(ZSH_COMPLETION); return 0
    repo=repo_path()
    ensure_repo(repo, init_output=True)
    store=Store(repo)
    cmd, ids, rest, ignore=parse_command(argv)
    if cmd=='version': sys.stdout.write('Version: Unknown\nGit commit: Unknown\nBuild date: Unknown\n'); return 0
    if cmd=='help': sys.stderr.write(MAIN_HELP); return 0
    if cmd=='_completions': return completions(repo, rest)
    if cmd in ('next','show-open','show-active','show-paused','show-resolved','show-templates','show-unorganised'):
        return list_cmd(repo,store,cmd,rest,ids,ignore)
    if cmd=='show-tags': return show_tags(repo,store)
    if cmd=='show-projects': return show_projects(repo,store)
    if cmd=='add': return add_like(repo,store,rest,ignore_context=ignore)
    if cmd=='log': return add_like(repo,store,rest,log=True,ignore_context=ignore)
    if cmd=='start':
        if ids: return transition(repo,store,ids,'active','Started')
        if rest: return add_like(repo,store,rest,start_active=True,ignore_context=ignore)
        eprint_error('nothing to do -- specify an ID or describe a task'); return 1
    if cmd=='stop': return transition(repo,store,ids,'paused','Stopped',rest)
    if cmd=='done': return transition(repo,store,ids,'resolved','Resolved',rest)
    if cmd=='remove': return remove_cmd(repo,store,ids)
    if cmd=='modify': return modify_cmd(repo,store,ids,rest,ignore_context=ignore)
    if cmd=='template': return template_cmd(repo,store,ids,rest,ignore_context=ignore)
    if cmd=='context': return context_cmd(repo,rest)
    if cmd=='note': return note_cmd(store,ids)
    if cmd=='edit': return edit_cmd(repo,store,ids)
    if cmd=='open': return open_cmd(store,ids)
    if cmd=='git': return git_cmd(repo,rest)
    if cmd=='sync': return sync_cmd(repo)
    if cmd=='undo': return undo_cmd(repo,rest)
    # Unknown commands are interpreted as default filters.
    return list_cmd(repo,store,'next',argv,[],False)

if __name__=='__main__':
    try:
        sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
    except BrokenPipeError:
        try: sys.stdout.close()
        except Exception: pass
        sys.exit(0)
